question: Which Linux companion implementation and long-term owner should become the supported path now that Windows Hub is delivered?
rationale: The remaining candidates make different language, dependency, packaging, and sensitive Gateway-control tradeoffs that cannot be resolved safely without maintainer product and ownership intent.

options.title: Sponsor C/GTK candidate
options.body: Advance https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/59859 after focused security and Gateway-contract review because it is mature, distro-native, and closest to the stated GTK direction.

options.title: Choose Rust/GTK candidate
options.body: Advance https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/61576 if maintainers prefer Rust safety and tooling enough to own its Cargo and packaging surface.

options.title: Defer native Linux app
options.body: Keep Linux on the supported Gateway and Control UI paths until a durable platform owner and acceptable security model are available.

recommendation.title: Sponsor C/GTK candidate
recommendation.body: Advance https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/59859 after focused security and Gateway-contract review because it is mature, distro-native, and closest to the stated GTK direction.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue history shows this person setting the intended Linux desktop direction and its roadmap priority.
